children: : Prices of white poultry, meat, fish, and dairy products varied on Sunday, September 20, according to data from the Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC).
The price of white poultry stood at nearly EGP 77.7 per kilogram, reflecting a daily rise of 0.9%. Likewise, the meat’s price increased by 1.3% to EGP 450.7 per kilogram.
Tilapia fish was priced at EGP 84.1 per kilogram, a decline of 4.6% daily.
The price of a liter of packaged milk fell by 0.2% to EGP 46.6, whereas a carton of white eggs amounted to EGP 104.7.
